tax.text: She said she would support raising taxes on the wealthiest people and large corporations to fund community services and investments.
tax.quote: Yes. I was an organizer for several Tax the Rich campaigns with NYC-DSA, and I am a co-sponsor of key legislation at the state level to do this currently.

wages.text: She supports a living-wage guarantee and stronger federal protections for union organizing.
wages.quote: Ensure everyone has the freedom to live a good life by guaranteeing a job with a living wage, paid parental and sick leave, quality health care, and a dignified retirement.

trade.text: She opposes current restrictive trade policies but supports renegotiating agreements with enforceable labor and environmental standards.
trade.quote: Claire knows these policies devastate workers on both sides of the border, and will push for the US to fundamentally renegotiate trade agreements to include enforceable labor and environmental standards that empower workers.

housing.text: She supports expanding housing supply through public investment.
housing.quote: A full supply of homes through public investment;

safety.text: As a state assemblymember, she supported the Treatment Not Jail bill as an alternative to incarceration.
safety.quote: Assemblywoman Valdez meets with advocates for the Treatment Not Jail bill. She is proud to support the bill.

immigration.text: She supports abolishing ICE and creating pathways to citizenship for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: I am going to bring this same fight to Congress, where I will work to abolish ICE, establish pathways to citizenship for all undocumented immigrants, dismantle the for-profit immigration detention industry

abortion.text: She supports codifying abortion rights nationwide and defending access to reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: Safe, accessible abortion is a right that should be afforded to everyone, without exception. But state bans have forced millions of people into dangerous, sometimes life-threatening situations

gender.text: She supports protections allowing transgender students and athletes to participate fully in school life, including sports, without exclusion based on gender identity.
gender.quote: defending the right of trans students and athletes to participate fully in school life, including sports; and ensuring that no federal agency, school, employer, or healthcare provider can use gender identity or sexual orientation as a basis for exclusion or discrimination.

health.text: She says she would sponsor Medicare for All and supports health care coverage regardless of employment.
health.quote: In Congress, Claire will sponsor Medicare for All on Day One and fight the insurance companies that profit from denying care and driving up costs.

energy.text: She supports a rapid transition to clean energy alongside investments in climate resilience.
energy.quote: Call for freezing electricity rates, holding corporations accountable, and investing in a rapid transition to an affordable, clean, and reliable energy system

voting.text: In a candidate questionnaire, she supported restarting the process to establish same-day voter registration in New York.
voting.quote: Do you support restarting the constitutional amendment process to enact same-day voter registration in New York? Yes

tax.text: He supports reinstating New York's stock transfer tax and directing the revenue to water infrastructure.
tax.quote: Support: New York State Bill S1237A Reinstate the Stock Transfer Tax (1905) Redirect revenue into: Drinking water systems

wages.text: His agenda supports workers’ rights to organize and negotiate fair wages.
wages.quote: Protect the right of workers to: Organize Protest Negotiate fair wages

safety.text: His agenda calls for fully funding law enforcement and increasing officer salaries.
safety.quote: Fully fund law enforcement Increase: Officer salaries

immigration.text: He proposes enforcement focused on criminal offenders while also creating expedited green-card pathways for long-term, law-abiding residents.
immigration.quote: Focus on criminal offenders Require proper warrants for enforcement actions Protect: Places of worship Civic and administrative appointments Legal Pathways Create expedited Green Card pathways

housing.text: She says she will expand access to affordable housing and homeownership for working families.
housing.quote: I will advance policies that expand access to affordable housing and homeownership for working families

safety.text: She favors criminal justice policies that invest in social services and address root causes to improve safety.
safety.quote: Safer communities come from solving root causes. Safety will be built through sustained investment in people.

energy.text: She supports climate-resilient infrastructure, clean-energy innovation, and stronger sustainability standards.
energy.quote: I support climate-resilient infrastructure, clean-energy innovation and stronger sustainability standards.
